_README: Content for /about. Checkable company facts (founding year, incorporation year, RC number, team size) live in src/lib/site.ts under COMPANY — one source of truth shared with the home page and the Organization schema. `team.members` ships empty on purpose; the whole section is hidden until real people are added, the same way clients.json works.

hero.h1: A small engineering team that ships.
hero.lede: Trajectra is a software company in Lagos, Nigeria, building products for clients wherever they are. We are not a body shop and not a consultancy that hands over slides — we write the code, deploy it, and hand you something your own team can carry on with.

principles.heading: Four things we do differently
principles.lede: Not values. Things you can hold us to, and check against how the engagement actually goes.

items.title: We tell you when not to build it
items.detail: The most useful thing we have said to some clients is that the thing they asked for would not solve their problem. It costs us the engagement and saves them a great deal more. If we think you should spend the money elsewhere, that is what the first call will tell you.

items.title: The code is yours from the first commit
items.detail: We work in your repository, not ours, and the IP transfers on payment. There is never a moment where the work is hostage to the relationship — which means the relationship has to be worth keeping on its own merits.

items.title: Fixed price, agreed before anything starts
items.detail: Scope, timeline and cost in writing up front. Changes go through a written change order. You will never receive an invoice you were not expecting.

items.title: We would rather end early than deliver badly
items.detail: Retainers exit on thirty days' notice, no penalty. If it is not working in the first month, we would both rather know in the first month.

location.heading: Lagos, working your hours
location.body: Our engineers are in Lagos, Nigeria. West Africa Time is UTC+1, which is a convenient place to sit: a full working day of overlap with Europe, the UK and Africa, a wide afternoon window with the Americas, and a morning window with the Gulf and South Asia. We run standups on your calendar, not ours.
location.note: Software engagements are remote worldwide. Work with a physical component — network and infrastructure design — needs people on site, so that is Nigeria-based in practice.

team.heading: Who you'll actually work with
team.lede: Named engineers, not a rotating pool.

_example.name: Full Name
_example.photo: /team/full-name.jpg — optional; a square image, 400px or larger. Omit and the card shows initials instead.
_example.bio: Optional. One or two sentences — what they work on, not a career history.

team._note: Copy `_example` into `members` to add someone, and delete the placeholder text. The entire section stays hidden while `members` is empty, so nothing half-finished can ship. Members also appear as Person entities in the Organization schema once added.
